name: constructor
body:
const p = data.props; const html = `

${p.title}

${p.sub}

Email: ${p.email}

`; document.getElementById(targetId).insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', html); env.funcs.listener(targetId); if (data.applicant_profile && env.funcs.profileHydrator) {env.funcs.profileHydrator(data, targetId, env);}
